truthNotes: Finish: brushed satin with fine parallel lines and one broad sheen, never high-polish; zero stones; identical pair. The three-quarter huggie shows its inner clicker seam and hinge pin (plausible hinge hardware; the outside stays seamless).
Colour: warm-neutral gold (hue 68-76, Lab b 16-21) on plum (dE76 42-66); the pair is the only gold.
Scale: 34.2 Feed px/mm, declared by the size tag on both Feed and Story.

Critic B: the Story's native frame is also about 2.1x life size (34.2 px/mm on both formats), so the 'Shown magnified · about 14 mm tall' tag is mandatory on Feed and Story; without it the picture fails truth.
